memoryBuilder.verseText: Jesus said: 'It is finished.' The work was all done.

sequence.prompt: What happened on that day? Put it in order.

items.label: They put Jesus on a cross
The sky went dark in the daytime
The temple curtain tore in two

matches.prompt: Match each part of the story to what it means.

pairs.right: He chose us instead of Himself
Paid and done — nothing left to add
The way to God is open now

application.question: Jesus took what we deserved. What would you like to say to Him?
application.followUp: Nobody took Jesus' life from Him — He gave it. He could have come down at any moment and He stayed, because saving Himself and saving us were two different things. And when the work was done He said it: it is finished!
